workshoptitle: Build Connected Telecommunications Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Build Connected Telecommunications Solutions with Oracle AI Database
tutorials.description: The SEER Telecomms telecom subscriber-support story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Use a converged query to connect service problems, service orders, semantic matches, and network-site locations.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas choose between JSON columns, JSON collections, and JSON Relational Duality for a subscriber application.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Search Service Plans by Meaning
tutorials.description: Review how Gilly built semantic search with an in-database embedding model for service plans and subscriber-support notices.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate an Activation Fraud Network
tutorials.description: Review Bob's graph approach to finding service orders linked by shared activation evidence with Oracle Property Graph and SQL/PGQ.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Find Nearby Network Sites
tutorials.description: Use Oracle Spatial for network site and network-region analysis.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Service Plan Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score a service plan demand-surge model inside Oracle Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Telecom Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn natural-language telecommunications questions into SQL you can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Telecom Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a telecom query agent that uses an approved SQL tool.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
